# secret-helper

Usage of the `secret-helper` command-line tool, as printed by `--help`.

```text
Usage: secret-helper [-hV] [COMMAND]
Generates the AES key for InvoiceWatcher and encrypts and decrypts secrets with
it. All values are read interactively from standard input.
  -h, --help      Show this help message and exit.
  -V, --version   Print version information and exit.
Commands:
  decrypt       Asks for the key and an encrypted value and prints the original
                  value.
  encrypt       Asks for the key and a value and prints the value encrypted
                  with AES-GCM.
  generate-key  Prints a new Base64-encoded AES-256 key.
```

## decrypt

```text
Usage: secret-helper decrypt [-hV]
Asks for the key and an encrypted value and prints the original value.
  -h, --help      Show this help message and exit.
  -V, --version   Print version information and exit.
```

## encrypt

```text
Usage: secret-helper encrypt [-hV]
Asks for the key and a value and prints the value encrypted with AES-GCM.
  -h, --help      Show this help message and exit.
  -V, --version   Print version information and exit.
```

## generate-key

```text
Usage: secret-helper generate-key [-hV] [-m=<mode>]
Prints a new Base64-encoded AES-256 key.
  -h, --help          Show this help message and exit.
  -m, --mode=<mode>   How the key is made: password derives it from a password
                        read from standard input (PBKDF2, random salt); random
                        is not implemented yet. Default: password.
  -V, --version       Print version information and exit.
```
